channel.title: AI Price Watch
channel.description: Dated price changes of AI coding and agent tools

item.title: Windsurf pricing change (2026-10-16)
item.description: Pro up from $15 to $20/mo; Max plan added at $200/mo; Teams now $80/mo per team + $40/mo per full seat. windsurf.com/pricing now redirects to devin.ai/pricing.

item.title: Tabnine pricing change (2026-10-16)
item.description: Public pricing removed: tabnine.com/pricing now redirects to a Tricentis contact form (quote only). Last published: Code Assistant Platform $39/user/mo and Agentic Platform $59/user/mo, both annual. (Checked 2026-10-16: the URL returns 301 to tricentis.com/contact-us.)

item.title: Replit pricing change (2026-10-16)
item.description: Pro plan now listed at $100/mo ($90 annual); Core stays $20/mo ($18 annual). Teams ($35/user in the 2025-11-07 capture) not shown.

item.title: GitHub Copilot pricing change (2026-10-16)
item.description: Max plan at $100/mo now listed (Free $0, Pro $10, Pro+ $39).

item.title: Cursor pricing change (2026-10-16)
item.description: The live pricing page now lists Free, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200 and Teams $30/user, with notes like 'Only Grok models are available on this plan'. The 2026-09-02 capture showed Individual $20/mo (Pro/Pro+/Ultra) and Teams $40/user.

item.title: ChatGPT (Codex) pricing change (2026-10-16)
item.description: Go plan now listed at $8/mo. Pro now shows from $100/mo with 3 usage tiers (was $200/mo in the 2025-09-04 capture). Plus stays $20.

item.title: Claude (Claude Code) pricing change (2026-03-01)
item.description: Team price cut: Standard seat $25 → $20/mo annual ($30 → $25 monthly); Premium seat $150 → $100/mo annual ($125 monthly).

item.title: Cursor pricing change (2025-09-22)
item.description: Pro+ plan added at $60/mo (Pro stays $20, Ultra $200).

item.title: Lovable pricing change (2025-09-05)

item.title: Cursor pricing change (2025-07-29)
item.description: Ultra plan added at $200/mo; Business ($40/user) now listed as Teams ($40/user).

item.title: Windsurf pricing change (2025-05-03)

item.title: GitHub Copilot pricing change (2025-05-01)

item.title: Claude (Claude Code) pricing change (2025-05-01)
